title: Sutra Apps registry index
description: The index a marketplace serves (ADR-039). Separate from the Claude-plugin marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): that one indexes Claude Code extension packages; this one indexes runtime content for Sutra Desktop. Only the index discipline is borrowed. Hosting (Publish program Q-1, 2026-09-12): the default index is website/apps/registry.json in the sutra repo, served at https://sankalpasawa.github.io/sutra/apps/registry.json; artifacts under website/apps/artifacts/.

publishers.description: who may sign entries (ADR-041). The plugin pins the default registry's keys in sutra-ui/registries.json; other registries are pinned on first install.

key_id.description: first 16 hex of sha256(raw public key)

pubkey.description: base64 of the raw 32-byte ed25519 public key

rotations.description: key rotations, each signed by the old key (ADR-041 P4)

signature.description: base64 ed25519 over the canonical rotation payload, by the old key

version.description: semver; equals the artifact's manifest publish.version

manifest_schema.description: the artifact manifest's `schema` value (codex P4 naming bridge)

artifact_url.description: the tarball of the app folder

sha256.description: of the tarball; verified before anything lands

publisher_id.description: required when the entry is signed; must name a listed publisher

signature.description: ADR-041 (Accepted 2026-09-12): ed25519 over the canonical payload {publisher_id, app_id, version, manifest_schema, artifact_sha256, sutra_version_range}. An entry without one is never installed from a registry (ruling P-3).

published_at.description: update detection: newer published_at with a compatible range = update_available (codex P3)

sutra_version_range.description: plugin versions this artifact runs on; outside the range = incompatible

network.description: page apps have no network reach (D-M5); true is not accepted in registry_schema 1

department_hint.description: a department NAME the installer may offer as the default placement; never a ref (refs are per registry)
